name: Detroit Open Data Portal

tos.evidence: No automated-access clause in portal Disclaimer or detroitmi.gov Privacy/Terms (read 2026-10-31). Terms bar commercial use without written permission; footer says material may only be used with permission. Non-commercial open-source demo; heads-up sent to gis@detroitmi.gov.

notes: robots.txt allows all with Crawl-delay 60 (probed 2026-10-31). Owner: open the portal in a browser, read footer terms, then set tosReviewed true. DCAT contactPoint is gis@detroitmi.gov.

name: Analyze Boston

tos.evidence: Default dataset license is ODC Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL); CKAN API is published for programmatic use. An older City of Boston Data License Agreement page also exists.

notes: Comparator. City runs an official MCP server for open data (Fast Company, Mar 2026).

name: Chicago Data Portal

tos.evidence: Terms excerpt reviewed covers liability and attribution; no automation clause seen, but the full data portal terms page could not be fetched.

notes: Comparator (Socrata). Owner: read data.cityofchicago.org terms in a browser before enabling.

name: Wikipedia

tos.evidence: Wikimedia robot policy: identify your bot via User-Agent with contact info and honor every robots.txt directive.

notes: Quick Knock positive example. Our UA includes contact info as required.

name: Michigan.gov (and State of Michigan portals)

tos.evidence: Michigan.gov Terms of Use (updated Dec 2021): users agree not to access the website through any automated means, including scripts and web crawlers.

notes: NO network requests. The agent stops at the door and shows the terms finding. Applies until DTMB grants written permission. Same treatment for data.michigan.gov, gis-michigan.opendata.arcgis.com and other state-run portals until their terms are confirmed.

name: Twitch

tos.evidence: Twitch Terms of Service bar accessing Twitch resources by robot, spider, scraper, crawler or other automated means for any purpose; API use is governed separately by the Developer Agreement.

notes: NO network requests to twitch.tv pages. Fun on-stream moment: the agent declines to knock on Twitch itself and explains why.
